is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.) as the malaria vector in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east) in Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes (Table 3 and Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (homozygous resistant, homozygous susceptible, heterozygous) for kdr-west and kdr-east in Kinshasa sites. Table 5 provides genotype counts for L1014F across eleven nationwide sites.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. larvae from multiple sites across the Democratic Republic of Congo.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis of insecticide resistance markers and bioassays.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for specific sites such as Kinshasa, Kasangulu, Lodja, Kapolowe, Kingasani, Mikalayi, Kalemie, Kimpese, Pawa, Karawa, Inongo, Kabondo, and Katana.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collection and testing conducted between 2016 and 2018.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new, original field collections and bioassays conducted by the authors between 2016 and 2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Table 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) and figures.

assessment.summary: This study monitored pyrethroid resistance intensity in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across the Democratic Republic of Congo before and after mass LLIN distributions. It reports both bioassay results and kdr (L1014F/S) genotype frequencies for field-collected populations.
